notes.subject: ⟨samting i stap⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'lukim long heven' tasol, Tok Pisin i nidim wanpela samting bilong lukim

notes.subject: המגביהי/המשפילי
notes.rationale: Partisip antap (v5) na daunbilo (v6) — tupela tok i stanap wantaim, Tok Pisin i holim

notes.subject: heven (dual)
notes.rationale: שמים em i dual — 'tupela heven' — Tok Pisin i tanim 'heven' tasol

translation: Em i go daunbilo bilong lukim ⟨samting i stap⟩ long heven na long graun.
